import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
import sys

# Load data
data_path = sys.argv[1]
data = pd.read_csv(data_path)

# Define linear function
def linear(x, a, b):
    return a * x + b

# Separate data into two regions
high_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] > 1000]
low_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] <= 1000]

# Fit linear models
popt_high, _ = curve_fit(linear, high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])
popt_low, _ = curve_fit(linear, low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection
A = np.array([[-popt_high[0], 1], [-popt_low[0], 1]])
B = np.array([popt_high[1], popt_low[1]])
intersection = np.linalg.solve(A, B)

# Output Tg
print(f"{intersection[0]:.2f}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import sys

# Load data
file_path = sys.argv[1]
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Define linear function
def linear(x, a, b):
    return a * x + b

# Separate data into two regions
high_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] > 1000]
low_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] <= 1000]

# Fit linear models
params_high, _ = curve_fit(linear, high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])
params_low, _ = curve_fit(linear, low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection
def find_intersection(p1, p2):
    a1, b1 = p1
    a2, b2 = p2
    x_intersect = (b2 - b1) / (a1 - a2)
    return x_intersect

Tg = find_intersection(params_high, params_low)

# Plot for verification
plt.figure()
plt.scatter(data['Temp'], data['Density'], label='Data')
plt.plot(data['Temp'], linear(data['Temp'], *params_high), label='High Temp Fit', color='r')
plt.plot(data['Temp'], linear(data['Temp'], *params_low), label='Low Temp Fit', color='b')
plt.axvline(Tg, color='g', linestyle='--', label=f'Tg = {Tg:.2f} K')
plt.xlabel('Temperature (K)')
plt.ylabel('Density (g/cm^3)')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('/results/10_feb_quenching/gpt_4o/react/quenching/task/level_1/brief/na2sio3_quenching_1_trial_1/density_temp_plot.png')

# Print Tg
print(f'{Tg:.2f}')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import linregress
import sys

# Load data
file1 = sys.argv[1]
file2 = sys.argv[2]
data1 = pd.read_csv(file1)
data2 = pd.read_csv(file2)
data = pd.concat([data1, data2])

# Sort data by temperature
data = data.sort_values(by='Temp')

# Fit two linear regimes
high_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] > 1000]
low_temp_data = data[data['Temp'] <= 1000]

slope1, intercept1, _, _, _ = linregress(high_temp_data['Temp'], high_temp_data['Density'])
slope2, intercept2, _, _, _ = linregress(low_temp_data['Temp'], low_temp_data['Density'])

# Calculate intersection
Tg = (intercept2 - intercept1) / (slope1 - slope2)

# Output result
print(f'{Tg:.2f}')
